verdict.rationale: Evidence shows individual payout, wallet, and transfer APIs (e.g., bvnk-docs-11, bvnk-docs-13, bvnk-docs-6) but nothing documenting a batch/bulk payout endpoint, mass-disbursement operation, or per-item status reporting for multiple payouts in one call. This is a fair axis for a payments platform, so absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
